name: po-claude-toolkit
description: Product Owner toolkit for Obsidian + Claude Code: git-like sync between an Obsidian vault and Confluence, plus creation of pages, folders and whole project trees, with Jira links, PlantUML and user mentions support.

plugins.name: confluence-sync
plugins.description: Git-like pull/push/status sync between local Markdown notes and Confluence pages, plus create-page/create-folder/scaffold to build a whole project tree from a template. Version messages, conflict detection, Jira smart links, PlantUML and Mermaid diagrams, Confluence user mentions.
